# U002 — Onshape always emits METRE; NX rescales as if mm (1000× too small)

## Sources
- 10-vendor-kbs.md V002 (forum.onshape.com discussion 762 importing-files-siemens-nx)

## Description

Onshape always emits length unit `.METRE.` regardless of workspace display unit. NX accepts only inch or millimetre and silently treats metric STEP as mm, yielding a 1000× too-small body.

## Reproducer recipe

`SI_UNIT($, .METRE.)` (no prefix) with coordinate magnitudes appropriate for metres; consume in NX configured for mm.

## Expected kernel behavior

read declared length unit verbatim; never assume; if display unit differs, scale internally.
